testimonials.quote: My journey at SNJB’s Late Sau K. B. Jain College of Engineering, Chandwad has been a perfect blend of academics, co-curricular activities, and industry-oriented exposure. The faculty members consistently motivated me to strengthen my technical skills while actively participating in extracurricular pursuits, contributing significantly to my overall development. The Training & Placement Cell provided invaluable guidance at every stage, from aptitude preparation to interview readiness. With their constant support and mentorship, I successfully secured my placement at Infosys with a package of 9.5 LPA. I am sincerely grateful to my college for offering me the opportunities and platform to grow, learn, and excel.

The graduates exhibit a solid academic foundation complemented by practical skills, enabling them to adapt quickly to real-world industry requirements. The emphasis the institution places on industry-oriented training, communication skills, and overall personality development is clearly reflected in the performance of its students. We appreciate the college’s commitment to nurturing industry-ready professionals and look forward to continued collaboration in the future.

testimonials.quote: SNJB College has played a significant role in shaping my personality. During my time there, I developed strong leadership, time management, and teamwork skills, and was able to elevate them to a whole new level. One of the most memorable aspects of my college life was my active participation in NCC and Sports. The lessons and experiences gained through these activities continue to guide me in my professional life, helping me manage my daily responsibilities with confidence and discipline. The emphasis placed on co-curricular and extra-curricular activities, alongside academics, was truly exceptional and made my college experience both enriching and enjoyable. The professors are the true strength of the institution. Their constant support, approachable nature, and dedication to teaching make them not just educators, but lifelong pillars of learning. The knowledge and values they impart are treasures that stay with you forever.

testimonials.quote: My journey at SNJB’s K. B. Jain College Of Engineering Chandwad was truly magical. Those four years were filled with unforgettable memories and joyful learning experiences. The friendly and supportive nature of the teachers made my college life even more special. Their approachable teaching style played a crucial role in shaping my academic achievements, making learning both engaging and inspiring. I am successfully working in an organisation, and I sincerely credit the excellent placement support provided by the college. The teachers here are more than educators — they often become friends and even personal mentors who guide you through challenges, both academic and personal. I am grateful to have been a part of SNJB and will always remain a proud SNJBian.

testimonials.quote: I am proud to be a graduate of SNJB KBJ College of Engineering, Chandwad (Passout Batch 2024). My journey at the college has been truly enriching, both academically and professionally. The dedicated faculty members, supportive learning environment, and industry-oriented curriculum helped me build a strong technical foundation and develop essential professional skills.The Training and Placement Cell played a significant role in preparing students for corporate opportunities through aptitude training, mock interviews, and career guidance sessions. With the continuous support and encouragement from the college, I secured placement at Motherson Sumi Wiring India Limited, Pune, in 2024. I am grateful to SNJB KBJ College of Engineering for providing the opportunities, resources, and guidance that helped shape my career. I highly recommend this institution to aspiring engineers seeking quality education and excellent placement support.
testimonials.name: Ms. Shradhha Bacchav
testimonials.attribution: Motherson Sumi Wiring India Limited, Pune
